She is wearing a form-fitting, white, sleeveless dress with a deep V-neckline and a low back. The dress has a fitted silhouette that accentuates her figure. She has long, dark hair styled in loose waves and is accessorized with a delicate necklace and a bracelet on her left wrist. The background features a black wall with various logos and text, including "TIFF," "Toronto," "Royal Bank," "VISA," "Ontario," and "Telefilm Canada."
